questions.query: I consent to participate in this control group post-experiment reflection survey
questions.text:
Research Study Consent - Control Group Survey

Study Title: Resource Allocation and Child Development Study - Control Group

Purpose: You have been randomly assigned to the control group. This survey collects your reflections about your experience in the resource allocation experiment.

What you will do: Reflect on your experience with the investment decisions and provide feedback. This should take approximately 5 minutes.

Confidentiality: Your responses will be kept strictly confidential and used only for research purposes.

Voluntary Participation: Participation is voluntary. You may withdraw at any time.
Thank you for completing the investment scenarios involving {child1name} and {child2name}. This final survey asks about your experience.

questions.query: Describe the strategy or approach you used when making investment decisions between {child1name} and {child2name} in the scenarios.
When making investment decisions between {child1name} and {child2name}, how did you typically approach their different abilities?
values: Invest more in the higher-ability child
Invest more in the lower-ability child
Invest based on each child's specific needs

questions.prefix: Rate the difficulty level (1 = Very easy, 5 = Very difficult)
